lines.en: I wade into the shallows step by step.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的手臂在水里拖着。
lines.en: My coral arms drag through the water.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把海底压出坑。
lines.en: My steps press pits into the seabed.

lines.zh: 身上不断有小珊瑚长出来。
lines.en: Small corals keep budding on me.
I'm slow, but I don't sink.
Water runs down through the seams in my shoulders.
My feet push the sand into little hills.
I walk the edge of the reef flat.
The hard growths on my back catch the light.
Turning takes me a long time.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，收进身体。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and take it into my body.
Fish part around my feet.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让水从指缝漏掉。
lines.en: I stop and let the water drain from my fingers.
I edge a little toward the shore.
My shadow sways on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，珊瑚碎屑落下。
lines.en: I raise a hand and coral bits fall.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一块长满珊瑚的礁。
lines.en: I stand like a reef overgrown with coral.
A small fish rests on my shoulder.
Water moves in and out of my seams.
I'm growing a new branch.
I lower my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我的手指被海水磨圆了。
lines.en: The sea has worn my fingers round.
I listen to the sounds under the reef.
A crab crawls over my foot.
I don't breathe, but the water moves.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面照在我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes down through the water onto me.
Salt has seized my joints.
I shake my shoulder and a few pieces fall.
There's a hollow in my chest.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一点，我露出来。
lines.en: The tide falls; I'm exposed.
You're standing off the reef flat.
I raise my head and water slides off.
You have no gills.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，水漫到你的脚踝。
lines.en: One step and the water reaches your ankles.
Your shadow falls on the coral.
I counted your gear.
I don't like being struck.
I look after this flat.
Step back and I'll return to standing.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两块海玻璃。
lines.en: My eyes are two pieces of sea glass.
A piece of coral drops off me.

lines.zh: 一块珊瑚从我肩上脱落。
lines.en: A piece of coral drops from my shoulder.
That knocked crumbs loose.
I shift back half a step, heavily.
Water gets into my seams.
Something rumbles inside me.

lines.zh: 我用手臂挡住裂开的缝。
lines.en: I cover the split seam with an arm.
My pace slows further.
You haven't broken me.
Sea water pours into the crack.
Your hands smell of sea water.
Leave it on the stone.
Coral rubble; I can take it.
I bend slowly.
This colour is like mine.
I'll keep this piece.
Don't hand it over; I'll take it.
This piece will grow.
The water washed it away.
More of it, if you have any.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞礁石。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting reef rock.
Pushing me is pushing a reef wall.
The coral scrapes your hand.

lines.zh: 我转得很慢，你却撞上了。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and you still hit me.
The water gets pushed aside.
A crumb falls off me.
Don't push my shoulder; it's loose.
A pit forms in the sand.
Move away and then I'll move.
The sound is muffled.
Another construct stands beyond the reef.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一条水沟。
lines.en: A channel runs between us.
I reach out; she does too.
Our corals grow into each other.

lines.zh: 她把一块石头放进我掌心。
lines.en: She sets a stone in my palm.

lines.zh: 我替她挡住了一股潮流。
lines.en: I take a current for her.
The tide covers us, then withdraws.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在沙底重合。
lines.en: Our shadows meet on the sand.
She pushes a stone toward me.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们两个一起盖住。
lines.en: The tide covers us both.
I pick up a piece of coral.
It settles into my arm.
I collect the prismarine shard.
Too heavy; I drag it.
It crumbles in my hand.
I hold it up to the light.
Something is glittering.
I fit it slowly into a gap.
This coral is dead.
I press it into the sand.
The water's moving over there.

lines.zh: 水里的血腥味推了我一下。
lines.en: The taste of blood in the water nudges me.

lines.zh: 我的珊瑚枝全指向那边。
lines.en: All my coral branches point that way.
My corals all stand up.
The current shows me the way.
It's too close to the flat.
I raise my arm.
I'll plant this step firmly.
It's still coming this way.
The water starts pushing me on.
I follow, very slowly.
It can't outlast me; I'll wait.
The tracks on the sand are clear.
My feet crush coral as they pass.
It's hiding behind the reef.
I put a hand out in front of it.
It's backed into shallow water.
It's just past the reef.
The water answers to me now.
I have it.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，水花四散。
lines.en: I bring my fist down; water sprays.
It's pressed into the sand.
My arm comes down like a reef column.
Broken coral is swept up.
It tries to run; I block the way.
It hits me and bounces off.

lines.zh: 我的拳把沙底砸出个坑。
lines.en: My fist punches a pit in the seabed.
My palm presses you into the sand.

lines.zh: 我一推，它撞在礁上停下。
lines.en: It hits the reef before it stops.
Drawing my hand back stirs the sand.
A new shadow stands on the reef flat.
My shoulders rise off the flat.
Sea water pours off me.
Coral begins growing on me.
The sand takes two pits under me.
The tide has just covered this flat.
Fish gather around.
My first breath is water.
I raise my head and see the sky.
I stand still for a while.

lines.zh: 火烤得珊瑚发白，我的表面裂了。
lines.en: Fire bleaches the coral and my surface cracks.

lines.zh: 落地时我身上掉了几块。
lines.en: Pieces break off me as I land.

lines.zh: 水太多，我沉下去又浮起来。
lines.en: Too much water; I sink and rise again.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的珊瑚全打散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my coral.
Something sharp lodges in a seam.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的关节锁住了。
lines.en: Magic locks my joints.

lines.zh: 我空了很久，长不出新枝。
lines.en: Empty for long, I grow no new branches.

lines.zh: 雷劈过我，全身的珊瑚都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning passes; all my coral lights up.
No water, and no floor.
